content: What is the Leader Completeness property in Raft and why does it prevent committed entries from being lost?

The Leader Completeness property in Raft ensures that if a log entry is committed in a given term, that same entry will be present in the logs of the leaders for all higher-numbered terms [Page 4]. This prevents committed entries from being lost because Raft's election restriction guarantees that a candidate cannot win an election unless its log is at least as up-to-date as any other node in the quorum [Page 12]. Since a quorum overlaps with the majority that previously committed the entry, at least one node in the voting quorum must possess the committed entry, preventing a leader with an incomplete log from ever being elected.
